        long m = scanner.nextLong();

        long[] sum = new long[105];
        long[] pw = new long[105];
        boolean OK = false;

        long p = 1;
        int mx = 0;

            sum[i + 1] = p + sum[i];

                break;
            }

        System.out.println(OK ? "YES" : "NO");

        if (OK) return;
        if (cur == target) {
            OK = true;
            return;
        }
        long remaining = sum[pos + 1];
        long next = pw[pos];

        if (cur - remaining > target) {
            return;
        } else if (cur + remaining < target) {
            return;
        } else {

            } else if (cur - sum[pos] > target) {
                process(cur - next, target, pos - 1, sum, pw, OK);
            } else {
                process(cur, target, pos - 1, sum, pw, OK);
            }
        }
    }
